messages.subject: input variable from ui.R
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to capture input value from Shiny UI part and based on the value I am filtering the records from dataframe. I am using below code:

dat <- sqldf("select * from dat where CMPNT_NM = 'input$Compound'")

It's not returning any rows. Just column name is coming. If I give any hardcoaded value like 'mP' then its running perfectly. 

Any idea if I am doing something wrong? I am new to Shiny and R both. Thanks in advance.

Regards,
Piyush

I mean you do not have to post the same question in two places: the
shiny mailing list, and the StackOverflow forum. In case you do,
please indicate that you are cross-posting, otherwise different people
might be trying to answer the same question in different places. If we
know it has been answered in one place, we can save our time by not
answering it again in the other place. In your case, your question has
been answered on StackOverflow, but there might be people who are not
aware of that, and try to answer it in the mailing list.

Regards,
Yihui
